meta.what: Share of 1,000 scattered landers whose touchdown point still passes the assumed power, comm and approach criteria for the 14-day mission, for each candidate site and landing date. Not the probability of a safe touchdown.
meta.method: pipeline/run_landing_success.py: the calculation of run_ghost_landers.py (pipeline/moonkeeper_b) for all sites and dates. Ground grid 80 m within 800 m of the site; horizon per grid point from NASA LOLA (terrain.py, 360 azimuths, 2 m mast); hourly Sun disc fraction and Earth visibility (any part of the disc); approach lighting = the site value for that date; Gaussian landing error 100 m along x 100 m cross track, heading = best approach azimuth, seed 0; Wilson 95% interval.
meta.limits: The landing error (sigma) and all criteria are assumed values, not mission requirements. One seed; the 80 m grid does not see smaller craters or boulders. Slopes, hazards and guidance are not modelled: this is the lighting and Earth-contact risk of missing the target, not a full landing-success estimate.
meta.terrain: NASA LRO LOLA GDR LDEM_85S_40M, LDEM_80S_80M (PDS)
meta.ephemeris: NASA/JPL Horizons sub-solar and sub-Earth points, DE441, hourly (data/derived/subpoints_2026_2028_1h.npz)
meta.si_use: Code written with Claude Code (SI) during the event; data are NASA LOLA + JPL Horizons.
